profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Idaho State Tax Commission
profile.summary:
I graduated from Boise State University (BSU) with a Bachelor's in Computer Science with an emphasis in CyberSecurity. I am currently employed with the Idaho State Tax Commission as a Software Engineer. 

During my time at BSU I have worked on individual and team-based projects that have focused on software and web development. This has given me a strong foundation with Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) using Java and C, exposed me to app and web development using PHP, HTML, CSS, SQL, SQLite, Javascript, jQuery, Node.js, React.js, electron.js, Jest, Git, and Github, and helped familiarize me with Google Workspace (G Suite) and Linux environment.

During my time at Boise Cascade Company, Mathnasium, and Orion integration Group, I have honed my skills in communication, leadership, time management, managing, teaching/training, and problem solving. These companies have also helped familiarize me with the Microsoft Office Suite and Windows environment.

positions.title: Agility Support Technician
positions.description:
Supported the Agility Maintenance team with various projects, including but not limited to the following:
- Performed product database reviews using DMSi Agility and Microsoft Excel to standardize data
- Researched, calculated, and updated appropriate weight conversions
- Separated, validated, and imported documents into OnBase
- Updated internal files manually and via import in Agility when necessary
- Assisted App Support team with initial rollout of new ASN (Advanced Shipping Notice) and POD (Proof of Delivery) process

positions.title: Lead Instructor
positions.description:
Managed both students and instructors on the floor. +normal instructor duties (listed under "Mathematics Tutor")
This included the following:
- Ensuring instructors are managing their group
- Administering Mathnasium assessments
- Inputting Mathnasium assessments and Mastery Checks into Radius (program used to keep track of everything)
- Updating the student's learning plan
- Contacting parents on student's progress
- Ensuring students aren't waiting too long for their questions to be answered
- Maintaining a peaceful and optimal learning environment for students
- Constant Contact (Keeping in contact with the student's teacher to ensure we are helping the student the best we can)
- Communicating with the Center Director regarding student progress and behavior

positions.title: Mathematics Tutor
positions.description:
Guided students through Mathnasium Curriculum and homework help.
This included the following:
- Playing math games with the students
- Keeping the students engaged in the math topics they are studying
- Answering any math questions students had
- Giving students multiple strategies to solve different types of math problems
- Managing 4+ students at a time - levels ranging from K-College

positions.title: Warehouse
positions.description:
Created, implemented, and maintained a system for unused and stocked products in warehouse. This included the following:
- Organizing and taking inventory of ALL products, tools, and company assets held in the warehouse
- Maintaining a master list of said things (in excel)
- Adding current market price for these items (for accounting purposes)
- Maintaining and creating forms to keep track of assets (used by warehouse, technicians, and product managers)
- Maintaining a clean, accessible, and hazard free warehouse

positions.title: Communications Technician/Installer
positions.description:
Installed, terminated, and tested telecommunications cable & wireless access points (WAPs)
This included the following:
- Using blueprints & floor plans to create the most efficient path for running data cable and keeping track of cable placement
- Operating a scissor lift to install, terminate, and test cable (also used to install WAPs)
- Terminating and testing at both the jack (wall) and the patch panel
- Using a Toner and probe to troubleshoot mislabeled cables
- Following OSHA regulations
